scenicChapters.title: Stelvio Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 63 km this is Stelvio Pass, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

milan-stelvio-and-gavia-serious-pass-day.story: Out of Bormio, one way: 180 km, roughly 3 h 27 in the saddle. The climb of the day is Stelvio Pass. It tops out at about 2,750 m. Stelvio Pass and Gavia Pass are open in summer only - check it is open before you set off. It crosses from Italy into Switzerland - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It is a high-mountain day.

waypoints.advice: The high point of this section, 621 m up. Next is Passwang road, climbing 322 m.

waypoints.name: Passwang road
waypoints.advice: Passwang road tops the climb at 943 m. The road climbs 322 m on the way up to it, steadily. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Solothurn food stop, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Solothurn food stop
waypoints.advice: A break here. You lose 513 m on the way down to it, steadily. Next is Hallwilersee water stop.

waypoints.name: Hallwilersee water stop

waypoints.name: back to Bremgarten old bridge

scenicChapters.title: Black Forest Panorama Route B500 South
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 28 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

facts.v: Black Forest Panorama Route B500 South

scenicChapters.title: Black Forest Panorama Route B500 South
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 25 km this is Black Forest Panorama Route B500 South, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

facts.v: Black Forest Panorama Route B500 South

scenicChapters.title: Black Forest Panorama Route B500 South
scenicChapters.narrative: 30 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it — this is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

facts.v: Black Forest Panorama Route B500 South

black-forest-wutach-schluchsee-escape-an.story: From Schaffhausen it runs 460 km to Bremgarten; allow about 8 h 22 of riding. On the way it passes Wutach Gorge scenic area, Schluchsee water stop, Todtnau forest roads and St. Blasien dome. The climbs: Staffelegg ridge road and Passwang road. It tops out at 943 m. It crosses from Switzerland into Germany - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. Rolling hill country.
